mapper.select: select id,certification_id,syllabus_version_id,row_version from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status='active' order by update_time desc,id desc limit 1 for update

select c.id collection_id,r.id revision_id,c.certification_id,r.collection_name,cert.certification_name, r.question_count,r.total_report_score::text total_report_score,r.duration_minutes,r.published_time::text published_time, '[]' subjects_json,'[]' question_types_json
mapper.sql: q.id question_id,qr.id question_revision_id,q.exam_subject_id,ci.item_order question_order,qr.question_type, qr.stem,qr.analysis,qr.answer::text answer_json,coalesce(qr.difficulty,'medium') difficulty, coalesce(qr.estimated_seconds,60) estimated_seconds, coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.evidence_group_key),''),concat('Q:',q.id)) evidence_group_key, ci.report_score::text report_score, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',o.option_label,'content',o.option_text,'sortOrder',o.sort_order) order by o.sort_order,o.id) from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=qr.id),'[]')::text options_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceUrl',im.source_url,'storagePath',im.storage_path, 'altText',im.alt_text,'sortOrder',im.image_order) order by im.image_order,im.id) from cm_question_image im where im.question_revision_id=qr.id),'[]')::text images_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('knowledgePointId',kp.id::text,'examSubjectId',kp.exam_subject_id::text, 'relationRole','tested') order by kp.id) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0' and not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=kp.id and child.del_flag='0' and child.status='0')),'[]')::text knowledge_json
mapper.select: select from cm_collection c join cm_collection_current cur on cur.collection_id=c.id join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=cur.collection_revision_id join cm_collection_item ci on ci.collection_revision_id=r.id join cm_question_revision qr on qr.id=ci.question_revision_id join cm_question q on q.id=qr.question_id where c.id=#{collectionId} and c.status='0' and c.collection_type=#{collectionType} and r.status='published' and r.collection_type=#{collectionType} and qr.status='published' and q.del_flag='0' order by ci.item_order
select id from cm_profile_rule_version where status='published' order by id desc limit 1

select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.collection_revision_id,s.rule_version_id,s.session_type,s.status,s.row_version, s.last_question_order,s.duration_seconds_snapshot,s.started_time,s.submitted_time,r.collection_name title, s.formal_attempt_no, count(sq.id)::int total_count,count(*) filter(where aa.answer_data->'value' is not null and aa.answer_data->'value' <> 'null'::jsonb and aa.answer_data->'value' <> '[]'::jsonb and aa.answer_data->'value' <> '""'::jsonb)::int answered_count from cm_learning_session s join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=s.collection_revision_id left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.attempt_no=1 left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.session_type=#{sessionType} and s.status in('created','in_progress','submitted','settling') group by s.id,r.collection_name order by s.create_time desc,s.id desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(formal_attempt_no),0)+1 from cm_learning_session where user_id=#{userId} and goal_id=#{goalId} and collection_revision_id=#{revisionId} and session_type=#{sessionType}
mapper.insert: with inserted as ( insert into cm_question_attempt(id,session_question_id,user_id,attempt_no,status,create_request_id,timer_status, is_blank,is_skipped,is_first_attempt,is_repeat_attempt,profile_applied) values(#{attemptId},#{sessionQuestionId},#{userId},1,'in_progress',#{requestId},'missing',true,true,true,false,false) returning id) insert into cm_attempt_answer(id,attempt_id,answer_data,grading_status,grading_source,grading_revision_no) select #{answerId},id,#{answerData}::jsonb,'pending','UNSCORED',0 from inserted
mapper.sql: s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.collection_revision_id,s.rule_version_id,s.session_type,s.status,s.row_version, s.last_question_order,s.duration_seconds_snapshot,s.started_time,s.submitted_time,r.collection_name title, s.formal_attempt_no, count(sq.id)::int total_count,count(*) filter(where aa.answer_data->'value' is not null and aa.answer_data->'value' <> 'null'::jsonb and aa.answer_data->'value' <> '[]'::jsonb and aa.answer_data->'value' <> '""'::jsonb)::int answered_count
mapper.select: select from cm_learning_session s join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=s.collection_revision_id left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.attempt_no=1 left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type=#{sessionType} group by s.id,r.collection_name

with locked_session as materialized ( select id from cm_learning_session where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type=#{sessionType} for update ) select from locked_session locked join cm_learning_session s on s.id=locked.id join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=s.collection_revision_id left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.attempt_no=1 left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type=#{sessionType} group by s.id,r.collection_name

with locked_session as materialized ( select id from cm_learning_session where id=#{sessionId} and session_type in('past_paper_exam','simulation') for update ) select from locked_session locked join cm_learning_session s on s.id=locked.id join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=s.collection_revision_id left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.attempt_no=1 left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.session_type in('past_paper_exam','simulation') group by s.id,r.collection_name
mapper.sql: sq.id session_question_id,a.id attempt_id,aa.id answer_id,sq.question_id,sq.question_revision_id,sq.exam_subject_id,sq.question_order, sq.evidence_group_key,sq.difficulty_snapshot difficulty,sq.estimated_seconds_snapshot estimated_seconds, sq.presentation_snapshot::text presentation_snapshot,sq.grading_snapshot::text grading_snapshot, sq.knowledge_snapshot::text knowledge_snapshot,aa.answer_data::text answer_data,aa.grading_status,aa.grading_result::text grading_result, aa.grading_source,aa.grading_revision_no,aa.score::text score,aa.max_score::text max_score, aa.score_rate::text score_rate,a.profile_applied,a.elapsed_seconds,a.timer_status
mapper.select: select from cm_session_question sq join cm_learning_session s on s.id=sq.session_id join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.attempt_no=1 join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where sq.session_id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} order by sq.question_order
mapper.update: update cm_attempt_answer set answer_data=#{answerData}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{answerId} and grading_status='pending'
update cm_learning_session set last_question_order=#{questionOrder},row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and status='in_progress' and row_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select session_id,question_order,attempt_id,lease_id,last_heartbeat_at from cm_formal_exam_timer_lease where session_id=#{sessionId} for update
select session_id,question_order,attempt_id,lease_id,last_heartbeat_at from cm_formal_exam_timer_lease where session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.update: update cm_question_attempt set elapsed_seconds=coalesce(elapsed_seconds,0)+#{seconds}, timer_status=case when timer_status='invalid' then 'invalid' else 'valid' end,update_time=now() where id=#{attemptId}
update cm_question_attempt set presented_at=coalesce(presented_at,now()),timer_status=case when timer_status='missing' then 'valid' else timer_status end,update_time=now() where id=#{attemptId}
update cm_question_attempt set timer_status='invalid',invalid_reason=coalesce(invalid_reason,#{reason}),update_time=now() where id=#{attemptId}

update cm_learning_session set status='submitted',submitted_time=coalesce(submitted_time,now()),row_version=row_version+1,status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and status='in_progress' and row_version=#{expectedVersion}

update cm_question_attempt set status='submitted',submit_request_id=coalesce(submit_request_id,create_request_id),submitted_time=coalesce(submitted_time,now()),update_time=now() where session_question_id in(select id from cm_session_question where session_id=#{sessionId}) and status='in_progress'
update cm_learning_session set status='settling',status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and status='submitted'
update cm_learning_session set status='completed',settled_time=coalesce(settled_time,now()),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and status='settling'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_async_job(id,job_type,business_key,payload,status,max_attempts,next_run_time) values(#{id},'FORMAL_EXAM_RESULT',#{businessKey},#{payload}::jsonb,'queued',3,now()) on conflict(job_type,business_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select status from cm_async_job where job_type='FORMAL_EXAM_RESULT' and business_key=#{businessKey}

update cm_async_job set status='running',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,started_time=now(), lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes',update_time=now() where id=(select id from cm_async_job where job_type='FORMAL_EXAM_RESULT' and ((status='queued' and next_run_time<=now()) or (status='running' and lease_until<now())) and attempt_count<max_attempts order by id for update skip locked limit 1) returning id,business_key,payload::text
mapper.update: update cm_async_job set status='succeeded',lease_until=null,finished_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='running'
update cm_async_job set status='queued',attempt_count=greatest(attempt_count-1,0), next_run_time=now()+interval '1 second',lease_until=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='running'
update cm_async_job set status='failed',lease_until=null,last_error=#{message},finished_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='running'

update cm_async_job set status='queued',attempt_count=0,next_run_time=now(),lease_until=null,last_error=null,finished_time=null,update_time=now() where job_type='FORMAL_EXAM_RESULT' and business_key=#{businessKey} and status='failed'
mapper.select: select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.collection_revision_id,s.rule_version_id,s.session_type,s.status,s.row_version, s.last_question_order,s.duration_seconds_snapshot,s.started_time,s.submitted_time,r.collection_name title,0 total_count,0 answered_count from cm_learning_session s join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=s.collection_revision_id join cm_formal_exam_timer_lease l on l.session_id=s.id where s.session_type in('past_paper_exam','simulation') and s.status='in_progress' and (select coalesce(sum(a.elapsed_seconds),0) from cm_session_question sq join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id where sq.session_id=s.id)>=s.duration_seconds_snapshot order by s.id limit #{limit} for update skip locked
select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_body::text from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{action} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,expires_time) values(#{id},#{action},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',now()+interval '24 hours') on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId},response_status=200,response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id}

update cm_attempt_answer set score=#{score}::numeric,max_score=#{maxScore}::numeric,score_rate=#{scoreRate}::numeric, grading_status='graded',grading_source=#{gradingSource},grading_result=#{gradingResult}::jsonb,grading_revision_no=1,graded_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{answerId}

update cm_attempt_answer set score=0,max_score=#{maxScore}::numeric,score_rate=0, grading_status='failed',grading_source='AI',grading_result=#{gradingResult}::jsonb,grading_revision_no=1,graded_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{answerId}
update cm_question_attempt set status='graded',is_blank=#{blank},is_skipped=#{blank},profile_applied=#{profileApplied},update_time=now() where id=#{attemptId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_learning_evidence where user_id=#{userId} and goal_id=#{goalId} and evidence_group_key=#{evidenceGroupKey} and is_valid=true and answered_at>=now()-interval '7 days'
select max(answered_at)::text from cm_learning_evidence where user_id=#{userId} and goal_id=#{goalId} and evidence_group_key=#{evidenceGroupKey} and is_valid=true
mapper.insert: insert into cm_error_record(id,user_id,goal_id,attempt_id,knowledge_point_id,evidence_group_key) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{attemptId},#{knowledgePointId},#{groupKey}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: insert into cm_profile_settlement(id,user_id,goal_id,exam_subject_id,knowledge_point_id,settlement_type,source_session_id,source_attempt_id,scoring_revision_no,settlement_revision_no,settlement_snapshot,entry_direct_ability,evidence_count,aggregate_evidence_value,positive_ratio,negative_ratio,effective_impact_coefficient,tentative_direct_ability,final_direct_ability,status,rule_version_id,request_id,settled_time) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{subjectId},#{knowledgePointId},'single',#{sessionId},#{attemptId},1,1,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','formal_exam_settlement/1.0','scoreRate',#{scoreRate}::numeric,'direction',#{direction}),50,1,#{scoreRate}::numeric*100,0,0,#{coefficient}::numeric,50,50,'settled',#{ruleVersionId},#{requestId},now()) on conflict(source_attempt_id,knowledge_point_id,scoring_revision_no) where settlement_type='single' do update set id=cm_profile_settlement.id returning id
mapper.insert: insert into cm_learning_evidence(id,settlement_id,user_id,goal_id,session_id,attempt_id,exam_subject_id,knowledge_point_id,evidence_group_key,behavior_type,difficulty_snapshot,score_rate,raw_evidence_value,direction,hint_level,elapsed_seconds,timer_status,hint_coefficient,time_coefficient,combined_coefficient,behavior_coefficient,streak_coefficient,is_distinct_question,is_valid,rule_version_id,answered_at,effective_at,settlement_sequence) values(#{id},#{settlementId},#{userId},#{goalId},#{sessionId},#{attemptId},#{subjectId},#{knowledgePointId},#{groupKey},#{behaviorType},#{difficulty},#{scoreRate}::numeric,#{scoreRate}::numeric*100,#{direction},'none',#{elapsed},#{timerStatus},1,1,1,#{coefficient}::numeric,1,#{distinct},true,#{ruleVersionId},now(),now(),coalesce((select max(settlement_sequence)+1 from cm_learning_evidence x where x.user_id=#{userId} and x.goal_id=#{goalId} and x.knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId}),1)) on conflict(attempt_id,knowledge_point_id) where is_valid=true do nothing

insert into cm_knowledge_profile(id,user_id,goal_id,knowledge_point_id,baseline_direct_ability,current_direct_ability,confidence_level,profile_status,distinct_question_count,last_direct_evidence_time,recent_trend,rule_version_id,calculated_time) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{knowledgePointId},50,50+#{coefficient}::numeric*(#{scoreRate}::numeric*100-50),'low','provisional',case when #{coefficient}::numeric=0.03 then 0 else 1 end,now(),'stable',#{ruleVersionId},now()) on conflict(user_id,goal_id,knowledge_point_id) do update set current_direct_ability=greatest(0,least(100,cm_knowledge_profile.current_direct_ability+#{coefficient}::numeric*(#{scoreRate}::numeric*100-cm_knowledge_profile.current_direct_ability))),last_direct_evidence_time=now(),rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId},calculated_time=now(),row_version=cm_knowledge_profile.row_version+1,update_time=now()
mapper.update: update cm_profile_settlement ps set final_direct_ability=kp.current_direct_ability,tentative_direct_ability=kp.current_direct_ability,update_time=now() from cm_knowledge_profile kp where ps.id=#{settlementId} and kp.user_id=ps.user_id and kp.goal_id=ps.goal_id and kp.knowledge_point_id=ps.knowledge_point_id

update cm_subject_profile sp set knowledge_aggregate_score=x.ability,subject_ability=x.ability,rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId},calculated_time=now(),row_version=sp.row_version+1,update_time=now() from (select kp.exam_subject_id,avg(p.current_direct_ability) ability from cm_knowledge_point kp join cm_knowledge_profile p on p.knowledge_point_id=kp.id where p.user_id=#{userId} and p.goal_id=#{goalId} group by kp.exam_subject_id)x where sp.user_id=#{userId} and sp.goal_id=#{goalId} and sp.exam_subject_id=x.exam_subject_id

update cm_overall_profile op set overall_ability=x.ability,rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId},calculated_time=now(),row_version=op.row_version+1,update_time=now() from (select avg(current_direct_ability) ability from cm_knowledge_profile where user_id=#{userId} and goal_id=#{goalId})x where op.user_id=#{userId} and op.goal_id=#{goalId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_assessment_report(id,session_id,user_id,goal_id,report_type,total_score,max_score,subject_scores,profile_summary,status,rule_version_id,generated_time) values(#{id},#{session.id},#{session.userId},#{session.goalId},#{reportType},#{totalScore}::numeric,#{maxScore}::numeric,#{subjectScores}::jsonb,#{profileSummary}::jsonb,'available',#{session.ruleVersionId},now()) on conflict(session_id,report_type) do nothing
mapper.select: select jsonb_build_object('score',total_score::text,'maxScore',max_score::text,'subjectScores',subject_scores,'profileSummary',profile_summary)::text from cm_assessment_report where user_id=#{userId} and session_id=#{sessionId} order by id desc limit 1
